name: Acrobatics
summary: Balance, tumble, and stay on your feet when the floor has other plans.
description:
The table's catch-all for not falling off a lava bridge, a motorbike, or a studio catwalk. Remi uses it as a way out. Waluigi uses it as a way to look like he meant to do that.
Waluigi's Note: If you are still standing after the floor moved, that is Acrobatics. If you are not, that is a filing. WAH.

name: Animal Handling
summary: Talk a beast into staying, leaving, or not eating the hire.
description:
Used on war-lions, ettercaps that used to be men, and Wario's motorbike when someone insists it counts. The archive files the beast under the person who named it.
Waluigi's Note: If it has more legs than you and you still gave it a name, that is this skill. WAH.

name: Arcana
summary: Read the Guild's work, the Mirror's geometry, and anything that hums without a motor.
description:
The Mages' Guild treats Arcana as a licence. Disaster Inc. treats it as a way to tell whether the glowing thing is a door, a bomb, or a filing error. July Summer Miser keeps the Jul'library on this column.
Waluigi's Note: If the Guild stamped it, it is Arcana. If they denied it exists, it is still Arcana, just louder. WAH.

name: Athletics
summary: Climb, shove, carry a body, or hold a stump while everyone else runs.
description:
Markop's column. Also anyone who has ever had to drag Waluigi, a notebook, or a paladin who is down to two hit points.
Waluigi's Note: Athletics is how you leave with the person you arrived with. The Legion calls the same thing a code. WAH.

name: Deception
summary: A lie that has to hold for one conversation, one costume, or one unlocked cell.
description:
Promo copy, fake IDs, a Luigi who is the wrong colour, and every time Wario says the notebook is not important. The archive prefers the lie that was said out loud — it files cleaner than the one everyone agreed not to mention.
Waluigi's Note: If they believed you, it is Deception. If they filed it, it is now canon and you have a problem. WAH.

name: History
summary: What the filings already said, and whether this year has happened before.
description:
The encyclopedia's own skill. Used when a session hands you a date, a dynasty, or a mountain with one T. The wrong mountain is still History — it is just History of a mapping company that no longer exists.
Waluigi's Note: History is the skill of not inventing a king who already has a page. WAH.

name: Insight
summary: Tell whether the person talking is lying, possessed, or just hungry.
description:
The Oracle, Carnivorous in Lady Aurelian's face, and every Guild clerk who smiles too long. Insight is how the table decides the costume is the story.
Waluigi's Note: If they answered to a name that was not on the page, Insight already failed and you are in a fight. WAH.

name: Intimidation
summary: Make someone stop, talk, or open a door they were paid to keep shut.
description:
Bowser's default. Also a commissar, a Colour Division introduction, and Wario with a claw. The archive distinguishes intimidation from violence by whether anyone is still standing to file it.
Waluigi's Note: If they moved because you asked loudly, that is Intimidation. If they moved because of the claw, that is a battle. WAH.

name: Investigation
summary: The desk skill: exhibits, leads, and which drawer the paper actually lives in.
description:
Not the investigation *file* — that is `investigations.json`. This is the roll that finds the charred note, the unlocked cell, the receipt Portia kept. Step 6 and Step 7 of a filing are this skill written down.
Waluigi's Note: Investigation the skill finds the paper. The investigation the file argues about it. Do not confuse the two or the docket grows a tumour. WAH.

name: Medicine
summary: Keep someone at two hit points instead of zero.
description:
Salam's hands, Dr. Toad, a Cordon combat chirurgeon, and the syringe that paid a Legion code back. Permanent injuries still go to the Injury Desk — Medicine does not unwrite a d100.
Waluigi's Note: Medicine is not a rewrite. It is how the person lives long enough to be filed. WAH.

name: Nature
summary: Trees that eat libraries, groves that are people, and whether wood burns.
description:
Feyward's working language. The first person in a week to ask whether wood burns was using Nature. Shadeward groves pretend they are the same skill and are not.
Waluigi's Note: If the plant has a face, it is Nature. If the plant had a face yesterday, it is Shadeward and you should have left. WAH.

name: Perception
summary: See the thing in the room before it sees you.
description:
Sentries, roll calls, a man with too many hands, and the notebook leaving in a courier's satchel. The archive treats a failed Perception as the start of an event, not a footnote.
Waluigi's Note: Perception is how you notice Luigi is the wrong colour *before* he smiles. After, it is History. WAH.

name: Performance
summary: A song, a show, or a CUT that stops a fight because the director said so.
description:
Plumber Man, Wario taking a bow to an empty house, Papyrus's puzzle theatre, and every RNN late slot. When the studio is the dungeon, Performance is Athletics for the face.
Waluigi's Note: If they clapped, it is Performance. If the director knocked Wario out, it is still Performance, just reviewed. WAH.

name: Persuasion
summary: Get a yes without a claw, a lie, or a contract you cannot read.
description:
The sixty-thirty split, Hjumpik's exchange rate, Bowser talking a one-week ultimatum up to three. Distinct from Deception: the other party still likes you afterward, or at least files the same number.
Waluigi's Note: Persuasion is a deal that survives the next session. Deception is a deal that survives the next sentence. WAH.

name: Religion
summary: Star Spirits, the Silver Flame, and whatever Jack's order actually swore to.
description:
Faiths are a live system. This skill is how a character *uses* one: last rites, a holy symbol with mushrooms on it, an oath that names a man before a crown.
Waluigi's Note: If the god answered, file it as an event. If the god did not, it is still Religion — they are like that. WAH.

name: Sleight of Hand
summary: Palm a notebook, a soul ring, a student ID, or the remote in the director's other hand.
description:
The courier's satchel, Remi's ID traded for an exit, Darian watching a wired remote pass. The archive files the object in inventory first, then admits how it moved.
Waluigi's Note: If they did not see you take it, Sleight of Hand. If they saw you and you still have it, that is Intimidation and we will argue. WAH.

name: Stealth
summary: Not being the person the grove, the studio, or the Legion is looking at.
description:
Bones leaving an inn, a Colour Division hallway, John Lee lost in his own castle. Failed Stealth is how most events start.
Waluigi's Note: Stealth is the skill of arriving in the filing as 'also present' instead of as the title. WAH.

name: Survival
summary: Track, forage, and not die of the weather while the plot happens somewhere else.
description:
Snowdin, the Skittering Grove, a motorbike in a bush. Survival is the skill of still having a route when the airlift does not come.
Waluigi's Note: If you ate, slept, and still know which way is out, that is Survival. The rest is commentary. WAH.

name: Chop Bros
summary: A verified twenty-five feet of Feyward violence with a name the table keeps using.
description:
Logged in the false-lady session: Chop Bros, a garlic grenade, a Bob-omb, and a soul ring engraved OC. Not a PHB skill. The archive keeps it because the transcript named it and the analysis filed the distance.
Waluigi's Note: If it has a nickname and a measured distance, it is a skill. If it only has a nickname, it is a bit. WAH.

name: Cheater's Gambit
summary: Nine seconds of Mister L, an unread note, and the first time the table named the cheat out loud.
description:
Filed at the lava bridge, 18 Harvestide 1035 BF. A Tanuki Leaf over a lava falls, a second smiling Luigi, and the rule that the cheat is part of the record.
Waluigi's Note: A gambit you write down is not cheating. It is a system. WAH.

name: Whispered Fireball
summary: Archie's first real Fireball on the record, whispered, with the grove still in the room.
description:
The Way I Started It: Archie puts the body down and whispers the first real Fireball. Not a shop ability. A named cast the commentary has to quote exactly.
Waluigi's Note: If you whisper a Fireball it is still a Fireball. The whisper is the filing. WAH.

name: No Man Left Behind
summary: The Legion code that moves a body, starts an argument, and sometimes comes back as a syringe.
description:
Spoken as 'you said leave no one behind, right?' The code took Eager off the field; the syringe paid it back. Not optional once someone has said it in earshot of a Cordon uniform.
Waluigi's Note: A code is a skill the other side also has. File both uses. WAH.
